description:
FOUND by s538b (#2371 probes).  perl 5.40.3, inside a DESTROY run at program exit:
  package D; sub new { bless {}, shift } sub DESTROY { warn "w"; eval { die "d" }; print "caught: $@" } package main; our $d = D->new;
  perl: stderr `w at FILE line 1 during global destruction.`, stdout `caught: d at FILE line 1 during global destruction.`
  PCL (s538b): the same without ` during global destruction`.
perl's mess_sv appends it whenever PL_phase is DESTRUCT.  PCL builds the ` at FILE line N.` tail in four places (p-die two arms, %p-die-text, p-warn-build-message): one helper reading ${^GLOBAL_PHASE} would cover them (rule 11).  Exact message TEXT is not a goal (USER s494), so LOW; it changes $@ text a DESTROY can read.
subject: a die / warn message raised during global destruction lacks perl's " during global destruction" location suffix (`w at F line 1 during global destruction.`) -- cosmetic
